items.what: BUG: every read failure is treated as 'no unit yet', which defeats the symlink guard on line 97 for a dangling symlink
items.why: If kiln-serve.service is a symlink whose target does not exist (a dotfiles link to a file not yet checked out), readFileSync throws ENOENT, `existing` stays undefined, the `existing !== undefined && lstatSync(...).isSymbolicLink()` check is skipped and writeFileSync follows the link, creating the unit inside the directory kiln says it does not manage; the report then says 'installed'. An EACCES is hidden the same way until the write fails. Fix: lstat first and refuse any symlink, and only treat ENOENT as absent.

items.what: BUG: pressing j or down on an empty skill list stores selected = -1, which is never clamped back to 0
items.why: With skills.length === 0, Math.min(0 + 1, -1) is -1; line 43 and line 63 then compute index = Math.min(-1, Math.max(0, n - 1)) = -1 for any n. Scenario: empty store, press j, press n, type a name, Enter. The skill is created, but start = Math.floor(-1 / pageSize) * pageSize is negative, skills.slice(start, start + pageSize) is empty, the 'no shared skills' line is also hidden, the counter reads 0/1 and Enter/l/f/x do nothing because current is undefined. Only j, k, u or p recovers. Fix: clamp with Math.max(0, ...).

items.what: BUG: terminal-features grows by three entries on every attach, because src/tmux.ts:77 re-sources this file each time and lines 24 and 29 append
items.why: applySettings runs `source-file` on every attach (src/tmux.ts:77, 96) and `set -ga` on an array option adds new indices rather than merging. Checked on tmux 3.7c with a throwaway server: 3 entries before, 12 after sourcing these two lines three times. A long-lived kiln server gains 3 duplicate entries per attach without bound. Fix: reset the option before appending (set -gu terminal-features) or set the full value without -a.
